reference_description: The line plot illustrates the training loss over steps for different models with a 20 million data size. The x-axis is labeled "Step", following a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 80K and gap then 420k to 440k, with tick label intervals of 20k. The y-axis is labeled "Train Loss", also on a linear scale, ranging from 0.0 to 0.4, with tick intervals of 0.2 and a gap then 0.75 and 0.85. Six lines represent different models. The red line, marking "ChemBART Small 20M", starts around 0.80 at 0k and decreases in hyperbolic manner with fluctuations to approximately 0.02 in between 430k and 440k. The blue line, "ChemBART Medium 20M" begins near 0.80 at 0k and decreases in hyperbolic manner with fluctuations to approximately 0.02 in between 430k and 440k. The green line, "ChemBERTa Small 20M", initiates at roughly 0.80 at 0k and descends to about 0.28. The orange line, "ChemBERTa Medium 20M," follows a similar pattern, starting at 0.80 at 0k and decreases in hyperbolic manner with fluctuations to approximately 0.02 in between 430k and 440k. The purple line, "ChemLLaMA Small 20M," begins above 0.80 and decreases in hyperbolic manner with fluctuations to approximately 0.02 in between 430k and 440k. While the brown line, "ChemLLaMA Medium 20M" starts just above 0.80 and decreases in hyperbolic manner with fluctuations to approximately 0.02 in between 430k and 440k. All lines exhibit a downward trend with some fluctuations, mostly reaching a steady state as steps increase. All the lines do intersect each other during the fluctuations, but green stays on top overall, while brown is at bottom overall. A legend is given in top right, describing the lines and color.
